## getBillingSummary

Get Billing Summary. `GET /analytics/billing-summary`

Get billing-aligned analytics summary.

Uses the EXACT same query logic as the billing aggregation service to ensure analytics numbers match billing 1:1. Breaks down outbound/inbound messages by platform, email campaigns by managed vs BYOK, push campaign messages, and knowledge base queries.

```php
$result = $sendseven->analytics()->getBillingSummary();
```

- Scopes: `analytics:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$startDate` | `DateTimeInterface\|string\|null` | no | Start of period (ISO format). Defaults to start of current month. |
| `$endDate` | `DateTimeInterface\|string\|null` | no | End of period (ISO format). Defaults to now. |

Returns `BillingSummary`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Analytics/get_billing_summary_api_v1_analytics_billing_summary_get)

## getCampaignPerformance

Get Campaign Performance. `GET /analytics/campaigns/performance`

Get campaign performance analytics.

Returns: - Aggregate campaign stats (total/completed, sent/delivered/read/failed). Volume tiles are invoiced-aligned: non-email campaigns from campaign_messages + email campaigns from email_campaigns. - Delivery and read rates - Email breakdown (email): single/transactional (1:1, from email_messages) vs campaign/newsletter (from email_campaigns), each aligned to invoiced usage. Legacy flat email_* fields mirror email.campaign.*. - Channel-type breakdown from campaign messages - Last 5 completed campaigns

```php
$result = $sendseven->analytics()->getCampaignPerformance();
```

- Scopes: `analytics:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$days` | `?int` | no | Number of days to look back |

Returns `CampaignPerformance`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Analytics/get_campaign_performance_api_v1_analytics_campaigns_performance_get)
